# Alliance Canada Technical Documentation

> The Digital Research Alliance of Canada (formerly Compute Canada) provides HPC clusters, cloud resources, and storage for Canadian researchers. This documentation covers cluster access, job scheduling with Slurm, software modules, storage systems, AI/ML workflows, cloud computing, and scientific software across national systems including Narval, Cedar, Graham, Béluga, Niagara, Trillium, Fir, Nibi, Rorqual, and Killarney.

Key facts:
- Job scheduler: Slurm (sbatch, squeue, sacct)
- Module system: Lmod (module load, module spider)
- Python: use virtualenv + Alliance wheels, NOT Anaconda/Conda
- Storage tiers: home (small, backed up), scratch (large, purged), project (shared, persistent), nearline (archive)
- GPU nodes available on most clusters (A100, H100, V100)
- Containers via Apptainer (formerly Singularity)
- Cloud via OpenStack (Arbutus, Nibi Cloud)

## Clusters & Systems

- [Fir](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Fir): Fir cluster at SFU — node specs, storage, access policies
- [Nibi](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Nibi): Nibi cluster — node specs, storage, policies
- [Narval](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Narval): Narval cluster at ETS Montreal — node specs, GPU nodes, storage
- [Rorqual](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Rorqual): Rorqual cluster — node specs, storage, networking
- [Trillium](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Trillium): Trillium cluster at U of T — 1224 CPU + 63 GPU nodes, H100s, specs
- [Vulcan](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Vulcan): Vulcan cluster — node specs, storage, policies
- [Cedar](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Cedar): Cedar cluster at SFU — node specs, GPU nodes, storage
- [Graham](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Graham): Graham cluster at U of Waterloo — node specs, GPU nodes, storage
- [Niagara](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Niagara): Niagara cluster at U of T — large parallel jobs, 80k cores
- [Arbutus](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Arbutus): Arbutus cloud cluster at UVic
- [National systems](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/National_systems): Overview of all national HPC systems
